PRIORITY FIXES
1
Write a proper meta description
Measured: meta description 181 chars

Your meta description runs to 181 characters, so search results will cut it off around 160. Rewrite it to 70–160 characters covering what you offer, what sets it apart, and the next step.

2
Rewrite the page title
Measured: title 67 chars

Your title is 67 characters, so search results truncate it at around 60. Lead with your main offering and audience, and put the brand name last.

Real output from a real audit. Not an illustration.
